messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — planning a router->runtime header-split flip during the change window tomorrow 2024-07-05 10:30 UTC. Need coord across API, runtime, console. Deploy-bot will run a phased canary. Anyone blocking?

Maria: We pinned runtime image to redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 this morning. No model schema changes, but KV eviction behavior changed (default tighter). Console will need a small schema bump to include route metadata. @Li can you confirm console is backward compatible?

Li: Console: PR merged (console-bff#541). It treats the new route metadata as optional so should be backwards compatible. Rolling that change into console-canary now.

Jin: API side: feature flag ready to steer by header. Plan is 1% -> 25% -> 100% with deploy-bot waves. Rollback criteria: if runtime p95 > 200ms or errors > 0.5% sustained across two 5m windows, we flip the flag off and pin router to legacy.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting phased rollout (canary cb-20240705-01). Targets: api-canary, console-canary, runtime-canary, router-canary. Track at /deploy/cb-20240705-01.

Maria: Heads-up: runtime KV cache warmup may produce a small error spike (~2-3%) for the first few minutes. Proposed mitigation: hold traffic for 10m after we hit 25% to confirm error-rate normalizes before proceeding.

Jin: Agreed. Add explicit guard: if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > 200ms for two consecutive 5m windows during the hold, we trigger rollback. Rollback steps documented in the playbook and alert #incidents.

Li: I updated console dashboards: route-change panel, per-variant traces, and token-cost breakdown. Also added a temporary alert to paging for route-change error > 0.5%.

Sam: Good. I'll draft release notes: runtime: kv-warmup default change; console: optional route metadata; api: header routing flag. Will include canary ID and rollback instructions. Anything else to call out?

Eve: Please add the router pin command to the notes so SREs can quickly act. Example: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/router/pin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"variant":"legacy","reason":"rollback"}'`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary wave1 completed (10m). No thresholds breached. Starting wave2 -> 25%.

Maria: Observability: p50 up ~12ms during warmup, p95 stable, error-rate within baseline. Holding for the planned 10m now.

Jin: If wave2 holds 15m with stable metrics, we can proceed to 100%. @Sam please be ready to cut release notes and confirm post-hooks.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Wave2 held 15m — proceeding to 100%. Running post-deploy smoke: `/ops/smoke/check_routes.sh`.

Sam: Thanks all. No incidents so far. I'll publish release notes and close the thread once post-smoke passes. :tada:

Li: Acknowledged — will keep dashboards on.

Maria: Marking runtime as pinned to v2.3.1 for this rollout.

Sam: Closing loop — final status: rollout complete, metrics stable, no rollback. Will add a short retrospective in release notes tomorrow. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
